notes.title: CODE: PANDORA 2
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!
Friends, fans — and yes, even haters.

While we're still preparing the remake of Witch 1, I’m excited to present the next chapter: CODE: Pandora.
Originally, the Absolute Weapon was supposed to be just a DLC for the first game — a small side adventure on a unique planet. But, as fate would have it, DLC development dragged on, and content kept piling up. So, with the iron will of the Dark Lord — and a random push of the launch button by our resident Goblin — it was decided: this story deserved a full sequel.

What’s different this time?
The biggest change: we’re no longer limited to a single planet. Now, your adventures will take you across nine worlds, with your headquarters stationed on the intergalactic base Ghost-5. From there, you’ll be contacting the lords of the Pandora galaxy, and your ultimate goal will be to piece together the full coordinates of the shadow planet where the Absolute Weapon is hidden.

There’s more — for the first time, Driply won’t be the only playable character. You’ll be joined by Lika, who, unlike diplomatic Driply, specializes in sabotage. But the choice is yours: plot daring sabotage missions, or befriend everyone in sight — it’s all up to you.

In the end, whether you get the coordinates by force, by cunning, or by friendship, the adventure will be yours to shape.

Thank you all for supporting the games and the Pandora universe — just as you did with Witch.

With love and respect,
Elbaf45

notes.title: WH4 - Voyage
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!
We have a DLC release today - Voyage. This is a small addition, but includes 19 new scenes + one.  The plot revolves around the missing maids, and moves to the under the moon world. There are three options to finish the game
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3534180/Witch_4_Hotel_Voyage/?curator_clanid=34719194
[list]
[*] 1- Use the absolute weapon at the very end, by selecting it in the dialog with the wagon driver. You can get it while playing as Melissa. Do not agree to ride with the conductor in his wagon, go ahead 1. Just take the ticket in the puddle (no need to say hello) 2. Orc when you pass him, go back and he's gone, take the ticket. 3) Tell the Succubus that the Orc is gone (when you take the ticket. Next, go back to the carriage driver, next to him take the chest, and give him the ticket. He takes you to his fortress and there you use the weapon.
[/list]
[list]
[*] 2 - Do not use absolute weapons, even if you have them.
[/list]
[list]
[*] 3. The scene of Chelsea and her double, you need to have sex with all the visitors of the restaurant (it is not difficult at all) and at the end do not use weapons after the scene with Melissa and Chelsea - you will have a second scene with Chelsea's double
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44974574/b7035119d5db28e15104a93503c1d70b6e13bd31.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44974574/0599140ffc179dd2155933c2d30dafb0bc22f4e4.jpg[/img][/url]
[/list]
[list]
[*] 4. Melissa is taken by the Carriage Driver, playing as Melissa fuck all the ghosts of the under the moon world and agree to go with the Carriage Driver in his compartment. (Chelsea is not supposed to provide sexual favors in the restaurant).
[/list]
[list]
[*] 5. This add-on is made so that you still come to the end of the journey. So some scenes you'll still miss by choosing between options, and I'll point out how to get them.
[/list]
[u][b]Hotel.[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] [u]Plumber[/u]: if you don't pay with money from the cash register, you will have a sex scene. But then there won't be a Seduction scene with Melissa. 
[/list]
[list]
[*] [u]Temptation[/u] - pay the last of the money to the plumber, then Melissa will go to room service.
[/list]
[b][u]Under the moon:[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] [u]Knight [/u]- If you don't want to entertain the knight, there won't be a scene, but he will send you down a long road.
[/list]
[list]
[*] [u]Scorpion [/u]- Examine the torch but don't light it, a scorpion will come running after 2 seconds.
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44974574/9a1f5af4b13fdbc40626315a053d439444a367ec.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44974574/bf4905dc4f0f44cc20e720307938480a911cdf8f.jpg[/img][/url]
[*] The bald trickster. - do as he wants, if you choose to leave he won't talk to you and you can go on.
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44974574/0dfcbea4f570f4448e53bacd73ca2014b12a0c12.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44974574/6ef03bbf8f621a74ce5d9edea0a6fcfc994e4e45.jpg[/img][/url]
[/list]
[b][u]Dungeon.[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] [u]Slug[/u]
If you don't want to serve customers, you can just leave the restaurant, you can leave right after the dialog with Chelsea's doppelganger. When you leave you will be in the dungeon - you need to find a way out, but if you stand and wait for all the torches on the walls to go out, you will get a scene with a 
slug. 
[/list]
[list]
[*] [u]Knight[/u]
Knight in the basement - You can just leave, for this you should not be afraid to climb into the coffin, but you can choose to provide services for the knight and get the scene.
[/list]
P.S
Absolute weapon is a gift from Dripley and we will be looking for it in the second part of CODE PANDORA. ːVR_helmetːːtainted_Loveː

notes.title: Witch 4 - Hotel
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone! Good to see you here again!
Witch 4 - Hotel. It's Chelsea again, swept away by ghosts, but this time bringing her sister with her.
Well, you're in for a little adventure around the big hotel. And as usual, nothing changes here - full hentai ending - if you tame all the ghosts past and present.
So, there are also little side quests for which you can get an extra scene. Such as Beer Skull, Colour of Other Worlds, etc
As for the Linux version and steamdeck, they will be coming within a few days. 
Nice to see you all again and thank you all for your support!
